name: Genting Berhad
overview: 2026年，以筹集约12.5亿令吉的总收益，用于一般企业用途及营运资金。公司还寻求股东批准续期经常性关联交易授权。本年度未公告任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。
overview_en: In 2026, Genting Berhad proposed a renounceable rights issue of new ordinary shares to raise gross proceeds of approximately RM1.25 billion, intended for general corporate purposes and working capital. The company also sought shareholders' approval to renew its mandate for recurrent related party transactions. No business segment expansions, reductions, disposals, or new contracts were announced during the year.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司层面提议供股集资，并寻求续期经常性关联交易授权。
segments.note_en: At the company level, a rights issue was proposed to raise funds, and renewal of the recurrent related party transactions mandate was sought.

actions.title: PROPOSED RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN GENT TO RAISE GROSS PROCEEDS OF APPROXIMATELY RM1,250 MILLION ("PROPOSED RIGHTS
actions.text_en: Proposed renounceable rights issue of new ordinary shares to raise gross proceeds of approximately RM1.25 billion.
